effect: Harmonic Unflinching and committed Super selection

primary.quote: Updated all Harmonic armor mods to change their element based on the currently equipped Super, rather than subclass.
primary.policy: Use equipped base Super definition tags, not a subclass marker, grenade, incoming attack or cast-time replacement.

compendium.rules: Matching-element ADS and 25/30/35 percent resistance tiers; previously verified original bytes retained.

clarity.conflict: The descriptions still say Subclass Element; official 8.0.0.1 explicitly moved all Harmonic mods to equipped Super. Keep original source text, override this identity rule only.

algorithm.copy_accounting: Each Harmonic source adds one copy only to the currently selected Super element profile. Elemental and Harmonic sources share that profile, with a combined cap of three.
algorithm.resistance: Completed ADS and defending held weapon element must match. Current selection is sampled during each query, independently of No Distractions and attack provenance.

uncertainty.topic: Mixed Harmonic and fixed elemental copies
uncertainty.status: explicit Chorus policy, inferred equivalent-mod accounting
uncertainty.policy: Add matching copies before the shared tier lookup; do not multiply separate mod tiers.
uncertainty.missing_evidence: No direct authoritative mixed-copy measurement was found in the consulted original table, Clarity or official update. Local tests prove the implemented policy, not original-game equivalence.

boundaries: Reference Super/grenade definitions are non-castable metadata fixtures in the real ability selection model. No dummy passive source is needed. They do not implement the Supers themselves or a complete Prismatic/subclass catalogue.
An empty Super slot or mismatching/kinetic weapon receives no Harmonic benefit. Only the requested holder and slot are consulted. Administrative source tags cannot impersonate a committed selection.

Current selection changes affect the next hit. Unchanged weapon perk state remains active under Chorus source lifecycle; original change-Super energy penalties and complete subclass/loadout constraints remain separate unfinished work.

The generic predicate freezes source-side selection at attack capture but retains victim-side queries for impact. Detached delayed rules read execution-time selection; checksummed domain restore retains the condition and selected base definitions.
Armor energy budgets, unlocks, equipment UI/HUD, ability NBT/cross-dimension persistence, base flinch calibration and complete physical-world restart remain incomplete.
